Warm ochre linen tunic, sage-green laced short waistcoat, roomy indigo patched trousers gathered at calves, ochre socks and robust walnut boots. Tiny wooden ear studs near her clearly pointed ears. Confident warm adventurous leader, distinctive broad shoulders and hips, never babyish, hands empty. Distinct face: mature full broad cheeks but firm squarish jaw, broad nose with rounded tip, deep dark skin, thick gently slanted eyebrows, warm narrow almond eyes, big expressive laughing smile. Adult strong curvy woman, NOT small round-eyed young girl. Long burgundy pointed cloth cap with leaf-edge fabric inserts and tip swept like a wave behind her head, two tiny wood beads threaded on its tail. One pendant made from a turquoise-painted wooden ring, and an ochre woven round shoulder pouch. Hat/ochre/teal/indigo clear contrast, only a few strong decorative accents.
